description: WHRO and Virginia’s public media stations asked people across Hampton Roads what they wanted to know from the candidates for Congress, then turned those questions into a questionnaire for every candidate in the race. I was glad to answer. These are your questions, and my answers are straight from me, in my own words, on the issues that matter most to our district.
